name: com.bnc.gimac.android.bnccomponentlibrary.service.FloatMeetingWindowServices
description: When a BNC GIMAC call continues after the user leaves its screen, this Service shows a movable call window with video and a way to return to the call. Disabling it stops calls from remaining visible in a floating window.
disableEffect: The user may lose the floating call window and have trouble returning to a call in progress.
